summary: 31st October – Sponsored Snacks for Senior Citizens of J J Dharamshala Our Club through 40 Reasons to Smile sponsored snacks and entertainment for 70 senior citizens of J J Dharamshala on 7th October, 14th October, 21st October and 28th October.
description:
31st October – Sponsored Snacks for Senior Citizens of J J Dharamshala
Our Club through 40 Reasons to Smile sponsored snacks and entertainment for 70 senior citizens of J J Dharamshala on 7th October, 14th October, 21st October and 28th October.
Amount Rs 4,500 ✖️ 4 days = Rs 18,000
Project cost Rs 18,000
Beneficiaries 70 each time, total 280 lives touched.
